# unifi_setting_teleport_enabled (Resource)

Manages only the enabled field of the Teleport singleton through the legacy API. Preserves all other settings. Do not combine with the full unifi_setting_teleport resource for the same site. Destroy relinquishes ownership without changing the controller. Import uses site:setting-id; no backend migration is performed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Do not combine with the full setting resource for the same site.
resource "unifi_setting_teleport_enabled" "example" {
  site    = "default"
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Teleport remote access is enabled. Set to `false` to disable Teleport while preserving its subnet and all other settings.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Replace the illustrative ID with the existing singleton ID for this site.
tofu import unifi_setting_teleport_enabled.example default:teleport-fixture-id
```
